title: kbask ask says when redaction changed the text it stored
goal: kbask ask prints a warning naming each span redact replaced in the stored ask (such as a session id inside a path), so the sender can reword before the worker reads it; SP-3pvz2noj: a runs path holding the orchestrator's session id reached the worker with the id zeroed

run:
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '_tools')
import inspect, kbask
assert 'redact' in inspect.getsource(kbask) and 'warning' in inspect.getsource(kbask), 'ask is silent when redaction changed the text'
